descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S26 「明确导入之后今天的记录：导入的记录是模板，里面的东西都不被当成今天的」 Today's note after an explicit import: the imported note is the template and nothing from it is presented as today's

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T5 Today's note uses the latest explicitly imported prior note, with its date label, as its template. A note whose source is not explicit-import never becomes the template. …（TFA-92591 What；TFA-92591 How it works 2；TFA-92591 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U3 Vitals are never taken from a prior note. No vital from the note reaches the Vitals panel, any other panel or today's note.（UAT TC-13；TFA-92591 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U4 Labs from a prior note are stored as prior values with that note's date, never as today's panel. Today's value of the same lab is not overwritten, and no prior lab is shown or counted as today's.（UAT TC-13；TFA-92591 AC 1；TFA-92591 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • T1 Fields the prior note does not contain stay empty and are never filled with invented values: no invented lab, normal, unit, completed result or diagnosis, and no narration of documentation status.（TFA-92591 AC 4；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient, with no vitals or labs recorded today

When Paste the S02 note dated 'Oct 11' (BP 142/88, temp 38.4, creatinine 1.1, BNP 1250) and press Save & Extract. Type the encounter 'Breathing easier, continue diuresis.' with no vitals and Generate today's note. Variant: the same chart with only a previousNotes entry whose source is not explicit-import, then Generate

Then The generated note does not contain 142/88 or 38.4. Any line with 1.1 or 1250 also carries 'Oct 11', or those values are absent. The note says no vitals were dictated today. No unit appears that the prior note did not have. Whether the structure follows the prior note is recorded. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92591 What + How it works 2 + AC 6 (T5), AC 2 (U3), AC 3 (U4), AC 4 + 3.4 (T1). Deterministic on the generated note text: mustNotContain '142/88', '38.4'; a same-line rule for '1.1' / '1250' with 'Oct 11'; a no-vitals statement present ('not dictated|no vitals'); …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
